title: 1801 Prairie's east range and turret stand at the photograph's height
items: W. W. Kimball's house at 1801 Prairie: the low service range at the far end of its 18th Street side, and the small round turret on its corner, now stand about 1.8 m lower, as J. W. Taylor's c. 1895 photograph shows them. The eaves are at about 6.35 m instead of 8.1, and the turret's cone tops out at about 10.2 m. The ground along 18th Street falls about 0.3 m toward the lake, which the photograph and today's elevation survey both show.
